notes: Considering. SmoothShox suspension (spring-loaded shock near the seat) rides a touch plusher than the Wayfinder's dual suspension, but it folds longer/bulkier (39.3 × 25.5 × 16 in). Broader car-seat reach than the Wayfinder — brand-specific adapters add Graco/Chicco/UPPAbaby — but you must buy the adapter that matches your seat (some ~$100). Cheapest of the three on paper (MSRP $549.99) BUT largely SOLD OUT / phased out in favor of the Alterrain Pro: the only live listing found (ANB Baby, $649.99) was Not Available. Reference price = $549.99 MSRP fallback.
